prompt: Generate a monthly financial report including revenue breakdown, expense categories, and year-over-year comparison charts

assertions.text: Explicitly identifies 'including' as a scope indicator that bundles multiple outputs into one story
Applies the 'Start with Outputs' technique (#1) — names it explicitly or clearly describes dividing by which output is delivered first
The first story does NOT include charts — delivers a simpler output first (text summary, basic table)
Each split story delivers independent value — the first story is useful without requiring the subsequent ones
Proposes at least 3 distinct stories, each incrementally adding one or two outputs
